facts.raw_span: A man in his early 60s with pathologic myopia
had undergone multiple procedures, including vitrectomy and cataract surgery, on the left eye for a rhegmatogenous retinal detachment 2 years previously
had received multiple intravitreous ranibizumab injections to the left eye for myopic choroidal neovascularization
Best-corrected visual acuities were 20/40 OD and 20/200 OS
Revealed emulsified silicone oil forming a meniscus in the fovea of the left eye
Demonstrated the confinement of the hyperoleon within a lamellar macular hole
Color images of the left fundus
Spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (OCT) showing hyperreflective dots within a lamellar macular hole
En face swept source OCT showing oil bubbles within its boundaries

concepts.why: The patient had undergone multiple procedures, including vitrectomy and cataract surgery, on the left eye for a rhegmatogenous retinal detachment 2 years previously.
The patient had received multiple intravitreous ranibizumab injections to the left eye for myopic choroidal neovascularization.
The en face imaging with swept source optical coherence tomography demonstrated the confinement of the hyperoleon within a lamellar macular hole.
The multimodal imaging revealed emulsified silicone oil forming a meniscus in the fovea of the left eye.
The patient had undergone vitrectomy and cataract surgery, on the left eye, and had emulsified silicone oil forming a meniscus in the fovea of the left eye.
The patient had undergone multiple procedures, including vitrectomy and cataract surgery, on the left eye for a rhegmatogenous retinal detachment 2 years previously, and had a lamellar macular hole.
The patient had pathologic myopia and had received multiple intravitreous ranibizumab injections to the left eye for myopic choroidal neovascularization.
It explains the decreased best-corrected visual acuity in the left eye due to the presence of emulsified silicone oil in the fovea.

rationales.F01: Pathologic myopia is a risk factor for myopic retinal degeneration.
rationales.F02: Previous vitrectomy and cataract surgery suggest a history of retinal detachment.
rationales.F03: Intravitreous ranibizumab injections are a treatment for myopic choroidal neovascularization.
rationales.F05: Emulsified silicone oil is a complication of vitrectomy.
rationales.F06: Lamellar macular hole is a type of macular hole.
rationales.F08: Hyperreflective dots within a lamellar macular hole are a characteristic finding.
rationales.F09: Oil bubbles within the boundaries of a lamellar macular hole are a sign of silicone oil emulsification.
